provenance.source: wx2 (legacy MSSQL, database wx2), 只读 SELECT
provenance.stock_scope: 本地 PG members_at(as_of=2026-11-23, dt=截面日, universe_id='all_a') 与事件日 2026-03-02 的 all_a 的并集
provenance.value_format: numeric(10,6) 的十进制字符串，原样保存；null 表示 wx2 对该股票无行

corr_vrlaglarge.sql: SELECT stock_code, corr_vrlaglarge AS v FROM dbo.stock_corr_vrlaglarge WHERE trade_date = %s

core_up.sql: SELECT stock_code, core_up AS v FROM dbo.stock_core_up WHERE trade_date = %s

core_down.sql: SELECT stock_code, core_down AS v FROM dbo.stock_core_down WHERE trade_date = %s

pxret21.sql: SELECT S_INFO_WINDCODE AS code, TRADE_DT AS d, S_DQ_ADJCLOSE AS p FROM dbo.ASHAREEODPRICES WHERE TRADE_DT IN (%s, %s)
pxret21.formula: (P_event - P_base) / |P_base|，P 为 S_DQ_ADJCLOSE；任一端缺失或 P_base=0 为 null
